sub_categories.label: OSAT assembly and test services
supplier_descriptions: receives bare dies and wafers from foundry and fabless customers, performs die attach, wire bonding, plastic encapsulation, trimming, and full parametric and functional test, selling finished packaged CMOS and mixed-signal integrated circuits back to chip designers and contract manufacturers

sub_categories.label: Power semiconductor packaging
